verdict.rationale: Filee's own llms.txt states it is "a free, open-source (MIT) file converter". It has a public GitHub repository (KnifeLemon/Filee) with build-from-source instructions for the .NET 10 SDK, so the source is readable under an open license. missing for 10: direct evidence of the LICENSE file in the repository, independent corroboration of the license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
